title: Community Rules
intro: Welcome to our community! To keep this space positive and valuable for everyone, please follow these simple rules:

rules.title: Be Respectful
rules.description: Treat others with kindness. No personal attacks, hate speech, or offensive language.

rules.title: Stay On-Topic
rules.description: Share content related to mushrooms, fungi, nature, and discoveries. Irrelevant or spammy posts may be removed.

rules.title: No Harmful Content
rules.description: Avoid unsafe handling tips, misuse of chemicals, or misinformation about mushrooms.

rules.title: Give Credit
rules.description: When sharing photos, research, or information about mushrooms, credit the original source whenever possible.

rules.title: Protect Privacy
rules.description: Don't share personal information (yours or others') publicly in the feed.

rules.title: Encourage Learning
rules.description: Ask questions, share discoveries, and help others grow their knowledge.

rules.title: Report Issues
rules.description: If you see harmful or inappropriate content, use the report feature or contact the moderators.

footerNote: ✨ Remember: This community is for learning, sharing discoveries, and appreciating the fascinating world of mushrooms. Let's keep it safe, friendly, and inspiring!
